batch.prompt: Create one isolated illustration: One terracotta-red desktop tape dispenser with a clear tape roll on its spindle, tape stretched to the clearly visible serrated cutting edge. Colour illustration for children, fine clean outlines and soft shaded colour fills. Use the named material colours visibly across the subject, not just its outline. Keep only the background white; naturally white parts may stay white. No monochrome sketch. Show only the requested concept, with its essential identifying details large and readable. No decorative scene, no lettering or card border.
